title: Page 164
transc:
No 13  1.30 pm
Richards Boston Mass.  Wash. Sept. 2. 1864
for Bologna Dresden period Biped is
in Dryden Number two Oliver Place
He will today or tonight receive
goods from Lawrence helix probably nautical
instruments Care of Winsor & Son
also clothes & letters from St Denis
Hotel period Watch him lookout for
the clothes & letters and seize
them and nutmeg him when it
is the right time ---- when
nugget - ed dont let him see
or communicate with anyone but bring
him immedy to Judah ---- The
letters & goods should be had
by all means Sig Claudius Mary


John Horner  Washn Sept 2nd 64 
Imogene for Palate Wm Hay France zebra Have your
duplicates of hen - roll - ment lists in your quincy
if so deposit the copies at Govern - whors Sidney
zodiac if you have not duplicates let the originals
be deposited there peru the boards doughnut require them
for daily reference stop the same with any other
important records which canby dispensed with optic offices Do
this so it wilby kept entirely secret signed Fry
